author: Nebula
description: Globally tracks Dank Memer adventure runs, rewards, losses, values, currencies, multipliers, Compass effects, per-interaction luck observations, a five-page Components V2 stats menu, and a network-wide leaderboard.
install_msg: Load with `[p]load adventuretracker`. Collection is enabled for all channels by default. Use `[p]adventure trackerstatus` to verify it is recording.
short: Accurate Dank Memer adventure statistics and leaderboard.
end_user_data_statement: Stores Discord user IDs, adventure backpack selections, interaction outcomes, item luck contributions, and game activity needed to calculate adventure statistics.
